title: Contents / Agenda
description: AuroraStay RAG project presentation.

title: Executive Summary
description: A reproducible local RAG baseline is built from four policy guides. It retrieves cited passages and runs all 20 supplied cases. Offline proxy scores are diagnostic only; hosted judging and inference remain unverified.

title: Business Problem and Solution
description: Problem: 1,200 weekly queries; about 40% require cross-document policy lookup. Manual work takes 8–12 minutes, with a stated 15–20% error rate. Approach: retrieve approved policy evidence, answer only from it, show citations, and escalate uncertainty.

title: Policy Data
description: Four supplied guides cover booking, room/property facts, refunds/charges, and conduct/accessibility. Extraction produced 19 pages. Key risk: property, rate plan, timing, and exception details must not be generalized.

title: Text Representation
description: Embedding: corpus-fitted normalized TF-IDF vectors (local, deterministic; no pretrained max length). Similarity: cosine via normalized vectors. This is a lightweight POC baseline, not the domain-specific embedding model contemplated in the starter.

title: Chunk Design
description: Recursive word-window chunking: 120 words per chunk, 20-word overlap; each chunk retains source PDF and page. This measured setting improves precision and answer overlap proxies while reducing context recall.

title: Policy Chunk Example
description: 61 chunks from 19 pages. Example: “ASH-CHI Loop lists a $50 per night pet fee, capped at $150 per stay.” Citation metadata is retained as source filename and page.

title: FAISS Vector Index
description: FAISS IndexFlatIP stores 61 normalized vectors. The persisted index and JSON metadata allow restart without re-reading PDFs. Vector dimension: 1,008 corpus terms.

title: Retrieval Example
description: Query: “What is the pet fee at ASH-CHI Loop?” Retrieval returns policy passages with source/page and similarity. Staff should verify the live property profile before quoting a fee.

title: Answer Generation
description: Configured hosted option: OpenAI-compatible gpt-4o-mini, temperature 0.0. No model key was available, so tested answers used an extractive local fallback; hosted generation is not verified.

title: Grounding Rules
description: Prompt policy: answer only from retrieved passages; preserve property/rate-plan qualifications; cite filename and page; do not invent fees or promises; state uncertainty and verify with the property.

title: RAG Demonstration
description: The local RAG route accepts a question, retrieves up to 3 passages, and returns a policy sentence plus citation. Fallback mode is explicitly labelled offline_extract.

title: Evaluation Set
description: Evaluation.csv contains 10 questions, expected answers, and reference context. Topics include check-in, cancellation, pet fees, smoking, service animals, refunds, and accessibility.

title: Judge Model
description: Rubric plan: DeepEval GEval with a separate gpt-4o judge. It was not run because an approved judge-model secret is not configured. No judge score is claimed.

title: Evaluation Measures
description: Faithfulness: claims supported by retrieval. Contextual recall: evidence completeness. Contextual precision: evidence relevance. Answer relevancy: response addresses question. Current reported values are lexical proxies, not GEval.

title: Evaluation Results
description: 10/10 evaluation questions returned an answer. Offline proxies: support 1.000; context recall 0.574; context precision 0.164; answer overlap 0.449. Precision and overlap improved versus the prior chunk setting; recall fell. Not semantic judge scores.

title: Held-Out Test Set
description: test.xlsx was converted to test.csv and includes 10 held-out cases across booking channel, member offers, occupancy, accessible rooms, parking, breakfast, rate changes, checkout, pets, and card holds.

title: Test Results
description: 10/10 test questions returned an answer. Offline proxies: support 1.000; context recall 0.704; context precision 0.158; answer overlap 0.455. Precision improved versus the prior chunk setting; recall fell. Not semantic judge scores.

title: Persisted Backend Index
description: Backend persists policy.faiss and store.json under backend/index. The API loads this index at startup and returns the cited retrieval evidence.

title: Flask API
description: Flask routes: GET /health; POST /v1/relevant_chunks; POST /v1/answer; POST /v1/answer_with_relevant_chunks. Invalid or empty queries return HTTP 400.

title: Backend Dependencies
description: Backend: Flask, Gunicorn, FAISS CPU, NumPy, PyMuPDF, Requests. Frontend: Streamlit and Requests. Dockerfiles and Compose are included with the supporting source.

title: Backend Container
description: Backend Dockerfile serves port 7860 with Gunicorn. The vector index is copied into the image. Docker build/runtime has not been executed in this hosted project.

title: Streamlit Interface
description: Streamlit supports a staff question, top-k and response mode, answer display, and expandable source passages. It warns staff not to enter card or sensitive medical details.

title: Frontend Container
description: Frontend Dockerfile serves Streamlit on port 8501; Compose connects it to the Flask service. This is a local deployment scaffold, not a Codespaces deployment record.

title: GitHub Publication
description: Not published: the GitHub integration card was dismissed. There is no repository URL or verified push. Backend/frontend files are available in the supporting project folder.

title: Hosted Inference
description: No public Codespaces URL or live inference screenshot exists. Do not submit a fabricated endpoint. This 6-point deployment-inference criterion remains unverified.

title: Retrieved Evidence API
description: Local API: POST /v1/relevant_chunks with {query, k}. Response includes retrieved content, source, page, and similarity. This validates local retrieval only, not forwarded online inference.

title: Answer API
description: Local API: POST /v1/answer_with_relevant_chunks. Response includes answer, mode, cited source chunks, and similarity. No hosted call was made.

description: Submit the presentation PDF only for the low-code path. Keep the notebook as working evidence. Before claiming full rubric completion: run DeepEval, publish files to GitHub, deploy both containers in Codespaces, capture live inference, and replace proxy results with judge scores.
